content: Barnabas le Saul
Antioch pawlpi sungah, kamsang le sya pawlkhat om hi; amate sia Barnabas, Niger a kici Simeon, Cyrene khuami Lucius, ngam uk Herod taw a khang khawm pa Manaen le Saul te a hihi.
Amate sia Topa naseam uh a, an a tan uh ciang in, Tha Thiangtho in Barnabas le Saul sia amate ka sap nathu nasep seam tu in a tuam in hong koi tuamsak tavun, ci hi.
Taciang amate antang in thu a nget zawk uh ciang, Barnabas le Saul tungah khut nga in, paisak uh hi.
Cyprus Theng
Tha Thiangtho in a sawl bangma in, Barnabas le Saul sia Seleucia ah pai uh a; tua mun pan in Cyprus ah tembaw taw pai uh hi.
Taciang amate Salamis ah a om uh laitak in, Judah te synagogue te sungah Pathian thuhil uh hi: taciang amate a hu tu in John zong om hi.
Tuikul sung theampo pai uh a, Paphos dong theng uh hi, tua mun ah mitbum thiam, leilot kamsang, Judah mi Bar-jesus a kici khat taw ki mu uh hi:
Ama sia Sergius Paulus a kici mipil ngam ukpa taw om khawm hi; tua Sergius Paulus in Pathian thu a zak nop man in Barnabas le Saul sam hi.
Ahihang a min khiakna mitbum thiam a kici Elymas in, ngam ukpa a upna pan ki khealsak tu in Barnabas le Saul te khak hi.
Tuazawkciang in Paul zong a kici Saul sia Tha Thiangtho taw kidim in, Elymas tangtak in en a,
Nang doaimangpa tapa, leilot thu le seksolna taw a kidim, phatngawlna theampo i ngal, Topa lampi pha te suksiatna pan in tawlnga ngawl lai tu ni ziam?

Tu in, en in, Topa khut na tungah om hi, na mittaw tu a, a ciangtan hun sung theampo ni na mu batu hi, ci hi. Taciang thakhatthu in a tungah meikai le khuamial hong theng a; a khut pan a len tu te zong in pai hi.
Ngam ukpa in a vawt te a mu ciang in um a, Topa hilna
te lamdangsa mama hi.
Pisidia Ngam Antioch Theng
Tu in Paul le a lawm te sia Paphos pan in ngunkuang taw pai uh a, Pamphylia ngam Perga theng uh hi: taciang John sia amate kung pan paikhia in Jerusalem ah cia kik hi.
Ahihang Perga pan a pai uh ciang in, Pisidia ngam Antioch theng uh a, sabbath ni in synagogue sungah tum in to hi.
Taciang thukham le kamsang te a sim zawkciang ulian te in ngual paisak a, no u le nau te, mite atu in hanthotna kammal nei na hi uh le, son vun, ci hi.
Taciang Paul dingto in, a khut van hi, Israel mite le no Pathian zakta te, ngai vun.
Hi Israel mite Pathian in i pu le pa te teal a, Egypt ngam ah peamta bang in a om laitak in lamsang hi, taciang a ban sangpi taw Egypt ngam pan in pusua hi.
Taciang senneal ngam sungah kum sawmli kiim anvak hi.
Canaan ngam a om minam sali te a suksiat zawkciang in, amate ngam sia aisan in hawm uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in kamsang Samuel hun hong thet ma kum zali le sawm nga sung, Pathian in thukhenmang te pia hi.
Tuazawkciang in amate in kumpi ngen uh a: Pathian in Benjamin minam Kish i tapa Saul sia kum sawmli sung pia hi.

Saul a hepkhiat zawkciang Pathian in David sia amate kumpi tu in lamsang hi; taciang ama thu Pathian in tettipang a, ka lungtang bang a nei Jesse tapa David ka mu zo hi, ama in ka deina theampo khuangkhim tu hi, ci hi.
Pathian in ama kamciam bang in Israel te ngumtu David suan Jesus tungding hi:
Jesus hongpai ma in John in mawna ki sikkik na taw kisai tuiphumna thu Israel mite theampo tungah hil masa zo hi.

Taciang John in a nasep a man tu ciang in, note in keima kua nong ci uh ziam? Keima sia Ama ka hi bua hi. Ahihang, en vun, ka nung pan in khat hongpai a, a peangdap khau sutsak tu zong ka kilawm bua hi, ci hi.
U le nau te awng, Abraham tate le note sungah Pathian a zakta te, hi ngupna thu sia note tungah hong kipuak a hihi.

Banghangziam cile Jerusalem a omte le ulian te in Jesus a heak ngawl uh hang ahizong, sabbath ni sim in a sim kamsang te kammal te zong a heak ngawl lai uh hu in, amate in Jesus mawsak in kamsang te thu tangtungsak uh hi.
Amate in Jesus tungah thi tak mawna a mu bua uh hi, ahihang Ama sia that tu in Pilate kungah ngen uh hi.
Jesus thu a ki atkholsa theampo te sia amate in a tangtunsak zawk uh ciang, thing tung pan in khiasuk uh a, than ah vui uh hi.
Ahihang Pathian in Ama sia thina pan thokiksak hi:
Ama taw Galilee pan Jerusalem dong a pai te in, ni tampi sung mu uh a, tua te sia midang te tungah Ama i tetti te a hi uh hi.
Taciang note tungah lungdamna thupha kote in kong tangko uh hi, tua thu sia i pu le pa te tung a kivawt kamciam a hihi,
Tua thu sia Pathian in ko a tate kungah Jesus a thawkiksak na tungtawn in khuagkhimsak hi; Psalm ni na sungah, Nangma sia ka Tapa na hihi, tu ni in kong nei zo hi, ci in ki atkhol hi.
Taciang Ama sia muat ngawl tu in thina pan a thawkik na thu taw kisai in, David i a muantak hesuakna kong pia tu hi, ci hi.
Mundang Psalm sung ma ah, na mi Thiangtho a muatthong tu na oai bua hi, ci hi.
Banghangziam cile David in Pathian deina bang in ama hun mihing te atu na a sep zawkciang mu a, a pu le pa te kungah vui in a pumpi muat hi:
Ahihang Pathian in a thawkiksak pa sia, a pumpi muat ngawl hi.
Tua ahikom u le nau te, hisia pa tungtawn in note tungah maw maisakna thu kong hil uh hi, ci kong hesak hi:
Moses thukham tungtawn in na san thei ngawl uh thutang suana sia Jesus upna tungtawn in a um theampo na theampo pan in thutang suana nga hi.
Tua ahikom kamsang te sonkhol nate note tungah hong thet thei ngawl natu in;
En vun, no ngual selno thei te, lamdangsa vun a, lalcip tavun: banghangziam cile no hun sungah, ka vawt nasep sia bangbang po ahizong na um bua tu uh hi, a ci thu sia kidawm vun, ci hi.
Taciang Judah te synagogue sung pan a pusua ciang in, Gentile mite in mai sabbath ni ciang in hi thu te hil tu in ngen uh hi.
Mipi te kikhop a man uh ciang in, Judah mi tampi le Judah biakna sung a tum Gentile te in Paul le Barnabas te zui uh hi: Paul le Barnabas in Pathian thuthiamna sungah om suak tu in hanthawn uh hi.
Paul Sia Gentile te Sang ah Kihei
A mai nipi Sabbath ni ciang in Pathian thu ngai tu in tua khuapi sung om buppi phial hongpai uh hi.
Ahizong Judah mite in mihonpi a mu uh ciang in, hazatna taw kidim uh a, Paul i thuhil nate langpan le sonsia in pau uh hi.

Tuazawkciang in Paul le Barnabas te hangsan seseam uh a, Pathian thu note kong hil phot uh kul hi: ahihang note in na vawk uh a, noma le noma tawntung nuntakna nga tu kiphu ngawl in thu na khen uh hi, en vun, ko Gentile te sangah ka kihei zo uh hi.
Banghangziam cile Topa in thu hongpiakna ah, Gentile mite khuavak hi tu in, lei mong khat dong ngupna atu hi tu in kong koi zo hi, ci hi.
Hi thu sia Gentile te in a zak uh ciang in, lungdam mama uh a, Topa thu poktek uh hi: taciang tawntung nuntakna nga tu in a koi sa te in um uh hi.
Topa thu sia tua ngamsung theampo ah kizel hi.

Ahihang Judah mite in biakna sang a ki pumpiak te le a zatakhuai nupi te, khuasung a om ulian te hanthawn uh hi, taciang Paul le Barnabas te nasia seseam in vawtsia uh a, amate ngamsung pan in hawlkhia uh hi.
Ahihang Paul le Barnabas te in a peang tung a bang leivui te thin uh a, Iconium sangah pai uh hi.
Taciang nungzui te sia lungdamna le Tha Thiangtho taw kidim uh hi.
